data.one_liner: Widgets to build displays that resemble mechanical flip boards and clocks.
data.what_it_does: Provides animated widgets like FlipWidget, FlipClock, FlipMatrixBoard, and FlipFraseBoard that simulate mechanical flipping boards and clocks. Content changes are animated with item streams and builders using middle-flip or spin-flip transitions.
use_when: You want to build a mechanical flip-style clock or countdown timer.
You need to animate content changes with a mechanical flipping board effect.
avoid_when: You require standard UI animations like fades or slides without the specific mechanical flip board look.
strengths: Includes ready-to-use compositions like clocks, countdowns, and matrix boards.
Customizable flip directions, hinge properties, and item builders.
weaknesses: Niche visual style that may not fit standard modern app designs.
Limited to specific mechanical flipping animations.

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: For general-purpose animation effects and timeline building rather than specific mechanical flip boards.

data.minimal_example:
FlipWidget(
  flipType: FlipType.middleFlip,
  itemStream: _stream,
  itemBuilder: _itemBuilder,
  flipDirection: AxisDirection.down,
)
